claims.text: Scoring derives evidence independence from distinct source_id/ref strings and never reads Evidence.independent_of, so two items tracing to one origin under different references score as fully independent sources.
boundary: src/aee/scoring.py independence computation (line 167-168)
src/aee/model.py Evidence.independent_of (declared, unconsumed)

evidence.description: source_ids = {item.source_id or item.ref}; independence_score = min(1.0, len(source_ids)/2.0). Distinct strings, not distinct origins.

independent_of appears only in model.py and the assessment JSON schema — write-only in practice. CORRECTION to the original finding as briefed: independence is not a flat silent 1.0 default; it is a string-count heuristic, and a 'Fewer than two independent supporting sources' note exists when the count is under two. The gap is that the heuristic cannot see shared origin and ignores the declared field.

falsification_tests: Show scoring code reading independent_of, or a bundle where two same-origin items under different refs score independence below 1.0 by default (current: independence = min(1.0, distinct source strings / 2)).
